text: Three weeks since she left and I still reach for my phone to text her about nothing. Sat in the car outside work for twenty minutes because I couldn't make myself go in.
Went past the flat we used to share. Stupid. Cried in a Tesco car park like a teenager. I keep replaying the last conversation looking for the part where I could have said something different.
Everyone keeps saying it gets easier. It has been a month. It has not got easier. I don't really want to hear it from anyone else right now.
Drank most of a bottle on my own again. Told myself it was to sleep. Woke up at 4 anyway with my heart going and felt worse than if I'd just lain there.
Said I'd take two nights off drinking this week. Managed one. Not really counting it as a win.
Bought a bottle on the way home before I'd even decided to. It's more automatic than I want to admit.
Cancelled on Priya again. Third time. She'll stop asking soon and honestly part of me would prefer that, which I know is the wrong way round.
Haven't left the flat since Friday except for the shop. Phone's been on silent. Twelve messages I haven't opened because opening them means answering.
My brother rang twice. I let it go both times then texted 'sorry, busy week' which is a lie. Not sure why lying was easier.
In bed at 11, awake until nearly 3. Same loop of thoughts going round. Gave up and watched something on my phone until it got light.
Woke at 4:15 again. That's five nights running. By the time the alarm goes I've already been awake for hours and I'm useless by lunchtime.
Slept maybe three hours. Everything feels like it's behind glass today. Snapped at someone on the phone at work over nothing.
Struggling to see the point of the effort. Not in a dramatic way, just tired of trying to hold it all together for a version of things that doesn't seem to be arriving.
Went through the motions today. Ate, worked, showered. Couldn't tell you a single thing I actually felt about any of it.
Missed the deadline. Didn't tell anyone. Now it's Thursday and it's still sat there and every hour it gets harder to bring up.
Big review meeting Thursday. Kept rehearsing it in my head on the walk in, which never helps, and it went fine anyway.
Workload's heavy but manageable. Stayed late twice this week. Noticed I'm short with people when it gets like this and tried to catch myself.
New project landed on me with no warning. Bit resentful about it. Went for a walk at lunch instead of eating at my desk, which helped more than I expected.
Took a while to drop off, maybe an hour. Slept through once I did. Not brilliant but not the worst.
Woke up twice in the night. Got back off both times. Still felt a bit foggy in the morning but it cleared by mid-morning.
Chest felt tight on the train. Did the breathing thing for a few stops and it passed. Annoying that it still happens but I handled it.
Bit on edge all day without a reason I can point to. Kept checking my phone. Went to bed early to cut the day short.
Went to the pub quiz but left at half time. Glad I went, glad I left. Enough people for one week.
Ordinary sort of day. Work, shop, telly. Nothing to report really, which I suppose is its own kind of report.
Up and down. Morning was rough, afternoon was fine. Hard to say what changed in between.
Good week. Ran twice, cooked properly instead of ordering in, actually looked forward to Saturday. Feels like I've got some room to breathe again.
Dinner at Marcus and Jen's. Laughed properly for the first time in a while. Stayed later than I meant to and didn't mind.
Slept well, woke up before the alarm and didn't feel like death. Got the admin pile done that's been sat there for a fortnight.
Went for a long walk by the canal. Didn't take my headphones. Quiet in a good way rather than a heavy way.
Steady day. Work was work. Made plans for the weekend which is more than I'd have bothered with a month ago.
Bit tired but fine. Nothing dramatic either way. Ate properly, got out at lunch, bed at a sensible hour.
Busy at work but the good kind. Felt on top of it for once. Left on time every day this week.
He's barely come out of the back room all weekend. Says he's fine when I ask, but he's not fine. I don't know whether pushing helps or makes it worse.
Cancelled on my sister's thing at the last minute. That's the second family thing this month. He said he was tired. He'd been on the sofa since two.
There were three empties in the recycling and it's Wednesday. I didn't say anything. I don't know how to say it without it turning into a row.
He'd clearly had a few before I got in. Told me he'd had 'one with dinner'. I know what one looks like and that wasn't it.
Heard him up again at half three. He goes and sits in the kitchen in the dark so as not to wake me. It doesn't work, I'm awake anyway, but I let him think it does.
Snapped at me over the dishwasher of all things, then apologised for twenty minutes. The apology worried me more than the snapping did.
He's gone very quiet. Not angry quiet. Flat. He'll sit through a whole film and I couldn't tell you if he watched any of it.
Asked how he was doing and got 'yeah, good, busy'. He's said that every day for a fortnight. I've stopped believing it.
Bit up and down this week. Grumpy Tuesday, much better by Friday. Nothing I'd have thought twice about a year ago.
Work's clearly getting to him. He was on his laptop till eleven twice. But he did come to bed when I asked, so.
Restless in the night, tossing about. Not up and wandering like he was before. Seemed alright in the morning.
Fairly normal week here. Some good days, one flat one. We went food shopping together which sounds like nothing but it was nice.
Best I've seen him in months. Suggested going out himself rather than me dragging him. Cooked on Sunday and made a proper mess of the kitchen, which I'll take.
He's been sleeping properly and you can see it in him. More patient, more himself. Laughed at one of my terrible jokes.
Steady week, nothing to flag. Normal ups and downs, nothing that stuck around.
Went for a walk together Saturday and he actually talked. Properly talked, not just answering questions. Felt like a while since that happened.
